import MumfordLib.SimplicialCohomology
import MumfordLib.SingularSmallCochainComparison

/-!
# Singular cohomology computed on small chains

For an open cover, restriction to its small singular chains is a
quasi-isomorphism of the actual integral cochain complexes. The induced
cohomology isomorphism is the canonical restriction map in every degree.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X : TopCat} {ι : Type*}

/-- Restriction of integral singular cochains to the small chains of a cover. -/
def integralSmallSingularCochainRestriction (U : ι → Set X) :
    integralSingularCochainComplex X ⟶
      integralSimplicialCochainComplex (smallSingularSubcomplex X U) :=
  integralSimplicialCochainPullback (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).ι

@[simp]
theorem integralSmallSingularCochainRestriction_f (U : ι → Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    (integralSmallSingularCochainRestriction U).f n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCochainPullback (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).ι n) := rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Restriction to the small chains of an open cover induces an isomorphism
on integral cohomology in every degree. -/
theorem integralSmallSingularCochainRestriction_quasiIso
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i) :
    QuasiIso (integralSmallSingularCochainRestriction U) := by
  rw [quasiIso_iff]
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [CochainComplex.quasiIsoAt₀_iff]
    apply shortComplex_quasiIso_of_cocycle_lift
    · intro α hα
      obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hrestrict⟩ := smallSingularCocycle_exists_lift U hopen hcover α hα
      refine ⟨φ, ?_, hrestrict⟩
      simpa [shortComplexFunctor', integralSingularCochainComplex,
        CochainComplex.of.d, singularCochainDifferential] using hφ
    · intro φ _ hφ
      obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := hφ
      have hzero : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f 0 ≫ φ = 0 := by
        change (integralSimplicialCochainComplex (smallSingularSubcomplex X U)).d 0 0 α =
          (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f 0 ≫ φ at hα
        rw [HomologicalComplex.shape _ 0 0 (by simp)] at hα
        exact hα.symm
      have hz := singularZeroCochain_eq_zero_of_zero_on_small U hopen hcover φ hzero
      subst φ
      exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | succ n =>
    rw [quasiIsoAt_iff' _ n (n + 1) (n + 2) (by simp) (by simp)]
    apply shortComplex_quasiIso_of_cocycle_lift
    · intro α hα
      have hα' : simplicialCochainDifferential _ (n + 1) α = 0 := by
        simpa [shortComplexFunctor', integralSimplicialCochainComplex,
          CochainComplex.of.d, Nat.add_assoc] using hα
      obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hrestrict⟩ := smallSingularCocycle_exists_lift U hopen hcover α hα'
      refine ⟨φ, ?_, hrestrict⟩
      simpa [shortComplexFunctor', integralSingularCochainComplex,
        CochainComplex.of.d, singularCochainDifferential, Nat.add_assoc] using hφ
    · intro φ hφ hboundary
      change IntegralSingularCochain X (n + 1) at φ
      have hφ' : singularCochainCoboundary φ = 0 := by
        simpa [shortComplexFunctor', integralSingularCochainComplex,
          CochainComplex.of.d, singularCochainDifferential, Nat.add_assoc] using hφ
      obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := hboundary
      change IntegralSimplicialCochain (smallSingularSubcomplex X U) n at α
      change (integralSimplicialCochainComplex (smallSingularSubcomplex X U)).d n (n + 1) α =
        simplicialCochainPullback (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).ι (n + 1) φ at hα
      dsimp only [integralSimplicialCochainComplex] at hα
      rw [CochainComplex.of_d] at hα
      obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := (singularCocycle_exists_primitive_iff_small U hopen hcover φ hφ').mpr
        ⟨α, hα⟩
      refine ⟨ψ, ?_⟩
      simpa [shortComplexFunctor', integralSingularCochainComplex,
        CochainComplex.of.d, singularCochainDifferential] using hψ

/-- The canonical restriction isomorphism from singular cohomology to the
cohomology of small singular chains. -/
def singularSmallCohomologyIso
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology X n ≅
      IntegralSimplicialCohomology (smallSingularSubcomplex X U) n := by
  letI := integralSmallSingularCochainRestriction_quasiIso U hopen hcover
  exact isoOfQuasiIsoAt (integralSmallSingularCochainRestriction U) n

@[simp]
theorem singularSmallCohomologyIso_hom
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularSmallCohomologyIso U hopen hcover n).hom =
      homologyMap (integralSmallSingularCochainRestriction U) n := rfl

end Mumford.Analytic
